subject: Combining display and closed storage
hook: Open shelves above the cupboards, or doors all the way up? Your alcoves, your call.
ig:
Open shelves above the cupboards, or doors all the way up? Your alcoves, your call.

Both are popular and both have a catch.

A: Cupboards with open shelves above
The classic alcove unit. Books, plants and photos bring the room to life, and the ledge on top of the cupboards is handy for a lamp. The catch: open shelves need styling to look good and dusting to stay that way.

B: Full-height doors
Everything is hidden, so the room always looks tidy, even mid-December with the wrapping paper out. The catch: in a smaller room, a full wall of doors can feel heavy, especially in a dark finish.

A middle ground some people like: doors all the way up on one side, shelves on the other.

Which would you choose for your alcoves, and what would you put on show? Let us know below.
fb:
A Sunday design dilemma for your alcoves: cupboards with open shelves above, or doors all the way to the ceiling?

Shelves give you somewhere for books, photos and the odd plant, but they need keeping tidy. Full-height doors hide absolutely everything, which is lovely in December, but can feel a bit heavy in a smaller room.
